facts.label: Comparar coisas
facts.sub: Adjetivos curtos: cheap, cheaper, the cheapest. Longos: more expensive, the most expensive. Irregulares: good, better, the best. Use than para comparar duas coisas.

facts.label: Curtos
facts.sub: Para adjetivos curtos, acrescente -er e -est: cheap, cheaper, the cheapest. Use than depois do comparativo: This one is cheaper than that one. Se terminar em y, troque por i: sunny, sunnier.

facts.label: Longos
facts.sub: Para adjetivos longos, use more e the most: expensive, more expensive, the most expensive. Use também com than: This one is more expensive than that one.

paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a cozy cafe in Austin. The sun shines on the wooden tables. Leo holds two new phones. His friend Luke sits across from him. Luke needs a new phone. He asks Leo for help.
“Hi, Leo! Which phone is better, this one or that one?” says Luke. “This one is newer, but that one is cheaper.” says Leo. “This one is more expensive. It’s the most expensive phone here.” says Luke.
